the treatment of bilateral DDH by means of open hip reduction with Salter osteotomy and femoral shortening (if indicated) is effective, with good radiographic results.
the results of open reduction and iliac osteotomy, with and without femoral shortening, are good, with a high rate of avascular necrosis, which is not a new finding.
